name: chrono
description: Development tooling for the Chrono Salesforce managed package
author: Karl

scripts.lint: sf code-analyzer run --workspace force-app --workspace tests/subscriber/force-app --rule-selector pmd:Recommended --rule-selector pmd:AppExchange --severity-threshold 3 --view table
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:lwc && npm run test:temporal && npm run lint
scripts.test:contracts: python3 scripts/check-service-boundaries.py && python3 scripts/check-global-api.py && python3 scripts/check-component-api.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/contracts -p "test_*.py"
scripts.docs:build: python3 scripts/docs/generate.py && prettier --write docs/reference && node scripts/docs/build.mjs && python3 scripts/docs/package-examples.py && python3 scripts/docs/check.py
